item.description: Tokyo Sims asks a guy to reveal a secret he's never told his girlfriend. His unexpected confession turns a casual street interview into a surprisingly personal conversation.

item.title: His Weirdest Dating Story Left Me Speechless
item.description: Tokyo Sims asks about the strangest experience someone has had with a partner, and the answer is anything but ordinary. A giant pillow, a mysterious entrance, and two hours later, there are somehow even more questions.

item.title: I Was Not Prepared for That Last Answer
item.description: A question about cheating somehow turns into one of the most confusing Tokyo interviews yet. The conversation keeps jumping in unexpected directions before ending with an answer nobody saw coming.
